svg.title: Amaranthe — 苋日
svg.desc: An amaranth sprig with three dense garnet flower tassels bending under their own weight, broad alternate olive-green leaves, and a supple reddish stem. Irregular pointed florets and fine curved leaf veins are drawn as a botanical engraving. The tassel form evokes Amaranthus caudatus without assigning the calendar's genus-level name to a single species.
